ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure; on the left there is an Et3N: fragment; in the middle there is an organic skeleton containing a six-membered ring, with the outside of the ring connected to a carbon bearing an S-methyl substituent, a carbonyl C=O, an R substituent, and an NH fragment; on the right there is an H—NEt3+ fragment. There are also multiple curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows and not counting bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: Expand the two amine fragments according to the specified method. In the left Et3N, each ethyl gives one N-C bond and one C-C bond, for a total of 3 N-C + 3 C-C = 6 non-hydrogen bonds. The right H-NEt3+ also has the same triethylamine skeleton, so it also has 6 non-hydrogen bonds; the H-N bond among them is excluded because it involves hydrogen. Count the middle skeleton according to heavy-atom–heavy-atom connections: the left six-membered ring has 6 bonds; additionally, the carbon above the ring to the carbon connected to S is 1 bond, that carbon to S is 1 bond, S to methyl is 1 bond, that carbon to the carbonyl carbon is 1 bond, carbonyl C-O is 1 bond, carbonyl C-R is 1 bond, and the connection from the lower ring carbon to NH is 1 bond, for a total of 13. Total = 6 from the left Et3N + 13 from the central skeleton + 6 from the right H-NEt3+ = 25.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First expand each amine fragment: Et3N on the left has 3 N-C plus 3 C-C bonds = 6 non-H bonds; H-NEt3+ on the right has the same 6 non-H bonds, while the H-N bond is excluded. Then count the central drawn skeleton once per heavy-heavy connection: 6 bonds in the left six-membered ring, plus the top ring carbon to the S-bearing carbon, that carbon to S, S to the methyl group, that carbon to the carbonyl carbon, the carbonyl C-O bond, the carbonyl C-R bond, and the lower ring carbon to NH connection, giving 13. Add all components: 6 + 13 + 6 = 25.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有一个 Et3N: 片段；中间有一个含六元环的有机骨架，环外连接到一个带 S-甲基取代基的碳、一个羰基 C=O、一个 R 取代基以及一个 NH 片段；右侧有一个 H—NEt3+ 片段。图中还有多条弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头，并且不计入涉及氢的键。

推理：按指定方法展开两个胺片段。左侧 Et3N 中，每个乙基给出一个 N-C 键和一个 C-C 键，共 3 个 N-C + 3 个 C-C = 6 个非氢键。右侧 H-NEt3+ 也有相同的三乙基胺骨架，因此也是 6 个非氢键；其中 H-N 键因涉及氢而排除。中间骨架按重原子-重原子连接计数：左侧六元环有 6 个键；再加上环上方碳到连接 S 的碳 1 个键，该碳到 S 1 个键，S 到甲基 1 个键，该碳到羰基碳 1 个键，羰基 C-O 1 个键，羰基 C-R 1 个键，以及下方环碳到 NH 的连接 1 个键，共 13 个。总数 = 左侧 Et3N 的 6 + 中央骨架的 13 + 右侧 H-NEt3+ 的 6 = 25。
